decisions.positionless_basequery: Usually less effective than positionless with leaf-first queries
decisions.positionless_pointhelper: No consistent gain over other positionless variants
decisions.copy_select: Retain cheap local copies for trivial actions and borrow nontrivial actions; next combined trial candidate
decisions.bitcache: No node-size increase; only active when derived byte fits base tail padding;128-bit update/prod improves
decisions.copy_bitcache: Best combined lazy candidate; selected for follow-up leaf-order/leaf-only-chunk/conditional-child trials
